title: Wound Healing: Total Contact Cast Vs. Custom-Made Temporary Footwear for Patients With Diabetic Foot Ulceration
brief_summary: Objective: to compare the effectiveness of irremovable total contact casts and custom made temporary footwear to heal neuropathic foot ulcerations in individuals with diabetes
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* confirmed diabetes
* neuropathic ulcer grade 1/2 (wagner scale)
* confirmed sensory neuropathy

Exclusion Criteria:

* osteomyelitis patients unable to walk
* life threatening co-morbidity ankle/brachial index , 0.4
condition: Neuropathic Foot Ulceration in Individuals With Diabetes
